title: Workspace pattern: resizable primary region, control rail, yielding panels, compact rail; Phase 2 candidate amendments
summary: Add a workspace pattern: a primary region that stays primary and can be resized by the person, side panels that yield (shrink, drawer, stack) before it, choices stored as preferences rather than measurements, and a compact icon rail for the application sidebar. Candidate principles P23 to P26 and candidate presets preset.workspace and preset.app-sidebar-rail travel as files in this folder; docs/WORKSPACE_PATTERN.md and the reference code (src/ui/workspaceGeometry.ts, src/ui/workspace.tsx, route #/workspace) are outside guidance/ and change no approved rule. It generalizes: any app with an image, canvas, preview, map or board as its main region hits the same layout problems. Open for the owner: ghost buttons (FB-0018) are deliberately not decided; whether the four size buttons are too many controls (P10); whether P26 needs a check; the CHK-011 collector matches every aside; the default size keeps panels at preferred width so it can be small on mid-size windows. CaissaTrainer Phase 2 extended this draft (FB-0020 to FB-0034): the size controls moved from the toolbar into a control rail attached to the region (FB-0020), optional tools and a duplicate view are closed by default and capped (FB-0021, FB-0022), the default is sized against panel minimums with the rail reserved on both sides (FB-0023), drawers are modal dialogs (FB-0024). Candidate amendments outside the workspace pattern are in candidate/amendments.md: tags and colour (AP-005, P06, CHK-005, FB-0025), equal surface check (FB-0028), editable text fields (FB-0026), toolbar density (FB-0027), honest toggles (FB-0034), repeated controls (FB-0030 to FB-0033), undefined class lint (FB-0029). Several are failures to apply approved guidance, not gaps (FB-0025, FB-0029, FB-0033, part of FB-0028); the proposal lists which. Draft only: the owner decides everything, including whether to split this proposal.

negative.description: Fixed-size central content: a 640px board or preview box. Too small on a large monitor, too large on a laptop, and the person cannot change it.
Storing a measurement as a preference: the window shrinks, the clamped size is saved, and the person's choice is lost for good.
negative.snippet:
const shown = Math.min(Math.max(size, 280), maxThatFits);
localStorage.setItem('size', String(shown));  /* P25: stores the clamp, not the choice */

negative.description: Panels that squeeze the primary region and vanish with no way back: a fixed 360px column on each side at every width, hidden by display:none on small screens.
negative.snippet: @media (max-width: 1000px) { .side { display: none; } }  /* P24: deleted, not yielded */

negative.description: Four size buttons in the page toolbar, far from the region they act on (FB-0020).
A category hue per ability repeated on every card, using the warning colour for one of them (FB-0025).
negative.snippet: .chip-calc { background: rgb(224 176 74 / .14); color: var(--warn); }  /* AP-005, P06, P04 */

negative.description: A drawer that sets focus on open but leaves the page behind it focusable (FB-0024).
negative.snippet: <aside role="dialog">...</aside>  /* no aria-modal, background not inert, Tab escapes */

negative.description: A second full size board next to the puzzle board, shown by default (FB-0022).

positive.description: Reference route #/workspace at 1440px: primary preview centered, panels docked at equal reserve, size controls and a corner slider handle.
At 1100px the panels shrink and the application sidebar is the 56px rail; the preview keeps its usable size (P23, P24).
At 390px the workspace stacks: the preview first at full width, panels below as sections, 40px touch targets (P24, P18).
Geometry is a pure function and the stored size is only an input.
positive.snippet:
const g = computeWorkspace({ width, height, padding: 16, gap: 16, chromeY, left, right, leftOpen, rightOpen, preferred: prefs.size /* null = responsive default */ });
prefs.setSize(pickedSize); /* the pick, never g.size */

positive.description: The same slice after Phase 2: duplicate board collapsed by default, capped at 240px, grouped options menu (FB-0022, FB-0027).
Rail options menu open on the reference route: a menu button with the four discrete actions.
Taxonomy chips removed, ability named in one plain line on the overview (FB-0025).

validation.notes: Re-run by claude-agent after the Phase 2 update (control rail in the React reference, geometry port with rail, gapX, default against panel minimums): result no-regressions on the 12 approved references at 1440 and 390, tap test pass, desktop layout comparison changed for trading@1440 only (57 elements), the same pre-existing time dependent flake of scripts/layout-snapshot.mjs recorded earlier; the other apps and trading@1100 show 0 changed. No candidate check is implemented, so no check outcome can change. #/workspace tap test: 34 tested, 0 undersized (one rail button at 32px was found and fixed during this run). Not an approval.

existingApplications.note: Existing applications are not changed. The 12 prototypes render identically (npm run test:desktop-layout). CaissaTrainer keeps guidance 0.1.0 in its summa-ui.usage.json until the owner approves a release and requests an update. AppShell gained an optional compact prop that is off by default.
